$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. MigrationPlan per FB-RAT-COM-011 — describes how a reader/store moves from one schemaVersion of SOME OTHER contract to another (major or minor compatibility, per FB-RAT-COM-003), plus the data migration and rollback it requires. Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<MigrationPlan> (see envelope.schema.json); `migrationId` below is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID.
title: MigrationPlan

migrationId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this migration plan (FB-RAT-COM-002).

contractRef.description: Stable identifier of the contract this plan migrates (e.g. a schema $id or a Kotlin type FQN), so one MigrationPlan is unambiguous about which schemaVersion sequence it applies to.

fromSchemaVersion.description: The schemaVersion this plan migrates away from.

toSchemaVersion.description: The schemaVersion this plan migrates to.

compatibility.description: Whether fromSchemaVersion→toSchemaVersion crosses a MAJOR boundary (old readers MUST reject the new payload per FB-RAT-COM-003 until they adopt this plan) or is MINOR (old readers preserve unknown fields and keep working unmigrated).

steps.description: Ordered, human-legible migration steps a store/reader executes to move stored data from fromSchemaVersion's shape to toSchemaVersion's shape.

reversible.description: Whether the data transformation described by `steps` is itself invertible (independent of whether a rollback plan is actually offered — see `rollback.possible`).

possible.description: Whether a rollback path is offered at all.

steps.description: Ordered rollback steps. MUST be non-empty when possible=true; MUST be empty when possible=false (a plan MUST NOT claim rollback steps it does not actually support).

issuedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this migration plan was authored (FB-RAT-COM-004).

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
